text: Morning — the chart colors you picked for me in July are unreadable again on the new build. Did something get reverted, or did I break it? No rush, I can live with it today.
Morning — the navigation survey closed over the weekend. 61 responses, and one person wrote about nine hundred words in the free-text box. You told me we read those ones. I am holding you to it.
Badge readers on three are out again. Nothing blocking — if you badge in and it beeps twice, that is why, and estates say Thursday.
Heads up, the coffee machine on two is dead again. The third floor one works and nobody has found it yet. Please keep it that way.
Nightly refresh failed and self-healed at 4:20 this morning. No action needed — flagging it so nobody is surprised by a gap in last night's numbers.
Morning — sprint goes up at 9:30 as usual. Nothing needed from you before then. Sven asked me on Friday whether we are on track for the quarter and I said yes, so let us both hope that stays true.
I switch off in ten minutes and I am gone for two weeks. Anything you need out of my head, now is the moment. Otherwise I will see you on the 24th.
Same message I sent Priya: off for two weeks in a few minutes. If there is anything you were going to ask me, ask it now or hold it until the 24th.
